text:
Lina (sales): FYI we have a POC kickoff with a Singapore customer tomorrow. They pinned model 'redwood-large-v1' in their request and are getting errors from AP-SG. Need an eng triage + quick pricing for a short dedicated trial and answers for a few security Qs from their compliance team. Logs below.
Devon (se): Can you paste the exact request and the error id? Also which SDK/param they used to pin the model? i.e. \"model: \"redwood-large-v1\"\" or a model alias?
Lina (sales): They used model: \"redwood-large-v1\" in the body. Error shown in their proxy logs (redacted):
```
2026-09-10T08:12:02Z request_id=8a4b2e model=redwood-large-v1 region=ap-sg status=404 code=MODEL_NOT_FOUND message=\"model variant not present in region\"
2026-09-10T08:12:03Z request_id=8a4b2f model=redwood-large-v1 region=ap-sg status=429 code=RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED message=\"no fallback route configured\"
```
They also tried a retry and saw 429. They asked: can you guarantee this model in APAC? If not, what are alternatives and pricing for a 2-week dedicated trial (predictable throughput)?
Samir (reliability): Model not present = deployment artifact not staged in that region. Two quick options:
- Enable model alias fallback so requests pinned to `redwood-large-v1` can route to `redwood-large-v1-quant` or `redwood-large-compat` if capacity missing.
- Provision a short dedicated pool in ap-sg for the trial (we can push a reserved unit for 14 days).
I can check deployment mapping but need the model hash / manifest id. Lina can you get the manifest or the version string? If not, we can map by model name but manifests are safer.
Anya (solutions): On the security questionnaire side they asked specifically about: KMS integration for key separation, SOC2 status, and data residency (logs not leaving region). We have standard answers but will need to know if the trial runs on Redwood Dedicated or Private. For hosted POC we can provide encrypted-at-rest and SOC2 docs; for strict residency they'd need a Dedicated trial in APAC or Private deployment.
Lina (sales): Customer prefers hosted but will consider a short dedicated trial if it's the only way to meet residency. They prefer pricing guidance asap — ballpark for a small dedicated pool for 2 weeks (2x A100-equivalents) and any activation lead time.
Devon (se): For immediate unblock I recommend enabling a fallback policy on their account route to a compatible model variant and reduce pinning, with a note that generation latency/cost may differ by variant. If they accept, we can also set per-request header `x-request-fallback: true` as a temporary workaround. Example request snippet:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-large-v1\",
  \"input\": \"...\",
  \"x-request-fallback\": true
}
```
That should avoid 404s while we provision if the fallback is configured.
Samir (reliability): I'll query model availability mapping now. @Infra-bot can you check whether `redwood-large-v1` is deployed in ap-sg and what the manifest id is?
Infra-bot: Checking deployment catalog...
- redwood-large-v1: not deployed in ap-sg
- redwood-large-v1-quant: deployed in ap-sg (replicas: 4)
- redwood-large-compat: deployed in ap-sg (replicas: 2)
Manifest ids: 
- redwood-large-v1 -> manifest: M-9a7c (deployed: eu-west, us-west)
- redwood-large-v1-quant -> manifest: M-9a7c-q (deployed: ap-sg, eu-west)

Samir (reliability): OK infra confirms. So the root cause: exact variant `redwood-large-v1` not staged in AP-SG. Short-term: enable alias fallback to `redwood-large-v1-quant` or `redwood-large-compat`. Long-term: we can stage primary variant but that requires provisioning lead time (24-48 hours for a fast push, potentially more if reserved capacity needed).
Anya (solutions): For the security doc answers, I'll draft the responses for KMS/SOC2/data residency and attach to this thread. If we do a dedicated trial, we can offer contract clause limiting logs to AP-SG and provide audit logs. Lina, I'll need customer contact email to send the questionnaire draft.
Lina (sales): Contact is jay.chen@examplecorp.com. They want an estimate for cost: what's a ballpark for 2 x A100-equivalent reserved for 14 days?
Samir (reliability): Ballpark: estimated infra cost ~ $8k-$12k for 2x high-end GPUs for 14 days (cloud/backing infra). Our recommended customer price would include margin + ops: propose $18k for 2 weeks as a short trial package (including monitoring + 24/7 support). I can refine after we confirm actual instance types and traffic profile.
Devon (se): Action items:
- Lina: confirm customer accepts fallback variant (we need explicit signoff that they accept potentially different latency/cost/quality) — due EOD.
- Samir/Infra: enable alias fallback on their account and add a temporary rule to route pinned=`redwood-large-v1` -> `redwood-large-v1-quant` in ap-sg — ETA 2 hours if approved.
- Anya: draft security questionnaire answers and send to Jay.
- Finance/SalesOps: produce a short-term dedicated trial quote (2x A100-equiv, 14 days) — aim to have by tomorrow morning.
Deploy-bot: created ticket INF-4521 \"AP-SG POC: enable alias fallback + dedicated trial quote\" assigned to infra, se, solutions. Link: https://internal.redwood/INF-4521
Lina (sales): Thanks — I'll loop back to the customer once we have the fallback option and the quote. If infra can turn on fallback quickly that's the fastest unblock.
Samir (reliability): I'll proceed to enable fallback once Lina confirms customer ok. If they want identical model artifacts we should plan a manifest push; that'll be a separate deployment ticket (longer lead time).
